name: jonathan-graniero-site
description: Personal blog and career site — React frontend, NestJS API, Postgres.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @site/api" "npm run dev -w @site/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @site/shared && npm run build -w @site/api && npm run build -w @site/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @site/api && npm run test -w @site/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @site/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
